chosen.condition: primary 37-dataset KEEL evaluation suite, frozen global hyperparameters
chosen.why_this_choice: Rule 3: no per-dataset table exists for any metric; G-mean and ROC-AUC are named as secondary metrics but no results table for them is printed, so PR-AUC (primary metric, Table 3, aggregate only) is the only option. Rule 4: abstract highlights gradient boosting ('ranks second of eleven under gradient boosting').

summary_rows.label: Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p, CISO vs method (HGB)

stat_test: Friedman test per classifier over all methods (Friedman p: LR = 0.0006, SVC = 8.8e-10, RF = 1.9e-08, HGB = 0.0036), then Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-dataset PR-AUC of CISO vs each competitor with Holm correction (control-vs-all); tie defined as |delta| < 10^-3

win_claim.quote: CISO is statistically equivalent to SMOTE on precision-recall AUC, ranks second of eleven under gradient boosting, and completes every one of 11,460 fold-level evaluations without failure.

notes: No per-dataset results table in the paper (main text through p.39 checked; no appendix tables), so rows is empty; only aggregate Table 3 (p.20) and Fig. 2 (p.21, per-dataset rank distributions as a plot, not numbers). G-mean and ROC-AUC are declared secondary metrics (Sect. 5.4, p.17) but their results are not stated in paper. Best-other per dataset: not stated in paper. Aggregate best mean rank under HGB is Random oversampling (5.05). Suites: primary = 37 KEEL datasets (Table 1, p.16, top); scale suite = 8 large UCI datasets (Table 1 bottom; results Table 6, p.27, ranks only, SVC omitted; CISO - SMOTE median PR-AUC diff +0.0016 LR, -0.0004 RF, -0.0003 HGB; Wilcoxon p 0.383/0.641/0.547); tuning suite = 5 KEEL datasets (Table 2, p.18: glass0, haberman, ecoli3, yeast3, abalone19), excluded from evaluation. KEEL datasets 37 + UCI 8 = 45 evaluation datasets. KEEL suite results in Table 3 cover 37 datasets. KMeans-SMOTE listed as a Tier-2 baseline but excluded from the primary predictive comparison because it failed on 50.3% of folds across 23 datasets (Sect. 6.8); Table 3 shows 10 competitors. Table text was extracted fine (not images).
